reviewer.scope: Read-only access to anonymous simulator screenshots and named chart source files

limits: The initial icon-only pass could not open the other images; the follow-up supplied exact paths.
The initial review did not show single-account ring widget faces or twelve-row widgets.
Widget and app screenshots used separate anonymous fixture sets.

changes: Requota name and quota-ring Q mark; thicker icon strokes and a clear tail.
Percentage text fits the ring centre without horizontal compression, including four-ring layouts.
Higher-contrast values and larger text in dense widgets; remove their decorative heading.
Distinct metric colours; individual history and activity use the corresponding ring colour.
Show every configured metric in tiles and name the allowance window in reset labels.
Keep search and provider filters visible in every layout.
Keep reported credits visible alongside quotas, including when an allowance is exhausted.
Fixed chart date domains and selection snapped to observed dates; tooltips remain within the chart.
Thin short-window traces on long periods, with user-controlled metric visibility.
Consumption heatmaps with a 24-hour day strip, weekday/hour matrix and aligned calendar month.
One set of shared period controls for account comparison heatmaps.
Tappable reset-event markers, with nearby events grouped.
Current-cycle percentage burn rates for 1h, 6h and 12h, with time-to-zero or reset-first status.
Preserve configured metric names across downgrades; distinguish known plan or allowance changes from resets and start a new forecast/history baseline.
decisions: Retain each account timestamp, as requested, rather than hiding fresh timestamps.
Continue lines across observed gaps; unavailable readings remain breaks. Do not add gap-count captions.
Do not automatically hide short-window metrics chosen by the user.
Consumption excludes reset drops and does not distribute long unobserved intervals across buckets.
Quota-level heatmaps remain an optional view.
Percentages are allowance points, not tokens. Amount charts require reported counters and matching units.
Credit balances do not imply active credit charging. Credit-usage and model/fast-mode breakdowns require provider-specific evidence.
Preserve installation, Keychain, App Group and widget identifiers during the rebrand.
implementation_order: Provider-specific details, starting with Codex and Claude where exposed

native_checks: Persistent compact search/display settings and debug export
Six selected Home Screen rows survive app termination and open the selected account
Four-ring 100% app displays and exhausted-allowance credits
Fixed-domain selection, event detail sheet, day strip and calendar month
Square tiles, saved drag order and comparison charts
Account picker and four-ring 100% small widget
live_protocol_checks: Cline native registration, identity, balance, refresh and renewed identity/balance
Claude authenticated profile plan and rate-limit tier
limits: Completed Gemini authorization remains for the owner’s existing account.
Cline’s completed browser/API authorization is distinct from native iPhone presentation/cancellation.

follow_up_changes: Summary bars use their usage-ring colour.
Shorten tiled weekly time to Wk time and dense weekly labels to Wk.
retained_choices: Provider/account palettes are adapted to distinguish adjacent ring colours; colours follow the configured rings, rather than imposing one global colour for a metric.
Retain optional short-window traces and per-account timestamps.
remaining_polish: Calendar text contrast and event target spacing can be refined further.
Tile header alignment when extra credit information is present.
